title: LiteLaby
description:
Server-side integration that hooks into LiteBans mute events and sends voice mute packets to LabyMod clients in real-time. Works on Velocity proxies and Spigot servers

Any issues, please contact me on discord: w1fl0w
body:
## LiteBans + LabyMod Voice Chat Integration

  Automatically syncs **LiteBans** mutes with **LabyMod** voice chat. When a player is muted, they are instantly blocked from using voice communication.

  ### Features
  - 🔇 Real-time voice mute sync with LiteBans
  - 🔊 Automatic unmute when LiteBans mute expires/removed
  - 🔄 Applies existing mutes when players join
  - ✅ Handles non-LabyMod players gracefully

  ### Requirements
  - **LiteBans** plugin
    _(https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/litebans.3715/)_
  - **LabyMod-Server-API** plugin 
    _(https://github.com/LabyMod/labymod4-server-api/releases)_

  ### Supported Platforms
  - Velocity (3.3+)
  - Paper/Spigot (1.17+)

  Single JAR works on both proxy and backend servers!

Any issues, please contact me on discord: w1fl0w
